description: Header file defining the RuntimeManagerImplementation class, which implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for a plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations, enums, method signatures, and external dependencies related to runtime control, telemetry, and container management.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing runtime management, configuration, and event handling for plugin operations, including container lifecycle, telemetry, and notifications.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::Configuration
classes.description: JSON container class for runtime configuration parameters, specifically the runtime application portal URL.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::Job
classes.description: Dispatchable job class for handling runtime events asynchronously.

classes.name: _RuntimeAppInfo
classes.description: Structure holding information about a runtime application instance, including IDs, state, and telemetry data.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for runtime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a runtime application with specified parameters.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes the specified application instance from a runtime state.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Forcefully kills the specified application instance.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific application instance.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds a key-value annotation to an application instance.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts necessary resources for runtime management.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts resources used for runtime management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the runtime manager with service parameters.
